claims.consumer_shape: accepted native CUDA work with per-invocation locks/scratch; shared and delegated Direct and Graph replay slots
claims.contract: failed terminal completion permanently retires its slot, rejected work stays retryable; all borrowed resources survive the real accepted prefix
claims.peer: existing HYLE Completion retention and one-byte invocation admission; no whole-peer timing claim
claims.scale: constant work per admission/terminal; exceptional unreturnable-prefix failure drains only accepted completions
claims.absolute: not timed; same one-byte state size/alignment and success-path atomic RMW count; terminal adds Status decoding
claims.sensitivity: W1 MSVC Release object disassembly plus four-platform source/static/shared and WSL sanitizers
claims.mechanism: idle/running/failed encodes retirement in the existing byte; no new normal allocation, search, memset, callback or wait
claims.limitations: P0 only; old CPU P1 and its accepted exception retain their original candidates; does not recover a lost device or qualify full CUDA route performance

claims.consumer_shape: CPU Direct and Graph construction with retained Native families, optional oneDNN and a borrowed public Sched executor
claims.contract: R3 composition/delivery scope only; existing algorithms, exact resource admission, cancellation and completion ownership remain with their original factors.
claims.peer: No new timing rank for the unchanged mechanism; CPU route workload comparisons are separate claims.
claims.scale: At most three configured Providers; cold prepare/compile, independent invocation storage.
claims.absolute: Factory adds no hot dispatch layer, private worker pool or per-submit allocation; existing cold planning/JIT/packing is explicit.
claims.ratio_ci: N/A: P0 structure and unchanged-product identity only.
claims.sensitivity: No cross-machine or unmeasured-op throughput inference.
claims.mechanism: Reuse Context/PreparedOperation, native CPU executor hooks, oneDNN BRGEMM and complete regions; fixed eligibility without timing profiles.
claims.limitations: This does not claim new P1 coverage for every retained Native operator or a CPU Q4 kernel.
